ModMetaData.name: Mindjack: Unique Weapons Enchanced
ModMetaData.author: toomanywyrms
ModMetaData.description:
Mindjack: Unique Weapons Enhanced adds some flavour to the unique weapons in Odyssey with it's own twist on the weapon bond system:
- Craft or purchase the Mindjack brain implant. - Register your Mindjack to the rudimentary AI via the weapon's Port. - While the weapon is equipped, enjoy enhanced performance both in and out of combat. - The weapon can still be used by others, however, at a greatly reduced efficiency. - Format your Mindjack to register a new weapon. However, be advised a registered weapon can never be re-registered, even to its old user.
